Name: Volcano Easy Pass
Description:
Gates and lava are part of discovering the volcano. On repeat visits, detouring for switches, [color=#b45f06]watering paths and finding the next exit can start to feel like routine interruptions[/color]. This mod offers optional shortcuts through those repeated steps.

The focus: less time opening the way, more time exploring and fighting.
[color=#f1c232]Automatic gates and lava paths keep a run moving,[/color] while visible exit markers make the next destination easier to identify. The mod does not change enemy strength or directly increase loot. The early summit shortcut stays off by default, so you choose how [color=#ffff00]much convenience to enable[/color].

Features and defaults
[color=#ffff00]• Automatic gates: enabled. Ordinary switch gates open without stepping on their buttons.
• Automatic lava paths: enabled. Lava becomes walkable stone while refill pools remain usable.
• Exit highlights: enabled. An outline, arrow and floor or summit label make the exit easier to spot.
• Early summit shortcut: disabled. Enable this separately to bypass the normal first-visit requirement.
[/color]
Installation and configuration
Requires SMAPI. Extract the VolcanoEasyPass folder into your game's Mods folder and launch through SMAPI. The mod writes config.json on its first startup, before a save needs to be loaded.
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional and provides individual switches. Use Reset to Default at the bottom of the mod's main configuration page to restore and save defaults. You can also edit config.json while the game is closed.
Disabling automatic gates or lava paths does not undo gates already opened or lava already cooled on the current floor. Newly generated floors use the new settings.

Multiplayer and compatibility
The host handles gates and cooled tiles through the game's native synchronized state. Install the same version on the host and clients for local lava passability updates and exit highlights.
This mod works independently of Spouse Errands and Animal Queue. Game assemblies and third-party dependency DLLs are not bundled.

Created by GPT6.

Updating and removal
Close the game before replacing the mod files. The download does not include config.json, so updates do not overwrite your settings. Remove the VolcanoEasyPass folder to uninstall.
第一次探索火山时，机关和熔岩是冒险的一部分；[color=#bf9000]反复进入后，绕路踩按钮、用水壶铺路和寻找出口也可能变成重复操作[/color]。这个模组为想减少这些步骤的玩家提供便捷开关。

核心体验：少处理通行手续，多专注探索与战斗。
自动开门和铺路减少中断，醒目的出口提示帮助快速判断前进方向。它不调整敌人强度或直接增加战利品；提前开放山顶捷径默认关闭，[color=#ffff00]由玩家自行选择便利程度[/color]。

功能与默认设置
• [color=#ffff00]自动开门：默认开启，不再需要踩机关按钮。
• 熔岩自动开路：默认开启，将熔岩冷却为可行走的石面，保留可补水区域。
• 出口提示：默认开启，提供醒目边框、箭头及下一层或山顶文字。
• 提前开放山顶捷径：默认关闭，可独立开启。关闭时保留正常解锁进度要求。[/color]

配置与安装
需要 SMAPI。将压缩包内的 VolcanoEasyPass 文件夹放入游戏 Mods 文件夹，使用 SMAPI 启动一次，即会在模组文件夹生成 config.json，无需先进入存档。
可选安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，在游戏内修改四个开关；配置首页底部的“重置为默认”按钮会恢复并保存默认值。也可退出游戏后编辑 config.json。
关闭自动开门或熔岩开路不会撤销当前楼层已经打开的门或已经冷却的地面，新生成楼层按新设置处理。

联机与兼容
开门和冷却由主机处理，通过游戏原生状态同步。为使每位玩家都获得出口提示及本地熔岩通行显示，主机和客户端均应安装相同版本。
本模组可单独使用，不需要配偶或动物跟随模组，不包含游戏文件或第三方依赖 DLL。

更新与卸载
退出游戏后用新版本覆盖同名模组文件夹；压缩包不包含 config.json，不会覆盖你的配置。卸载时移走 VolcanoEasyPass 文件夹即可。
